question: Build a decision tree classifier to predict drug response (responder vs. non-responder) from patient genetic variants (SNPs) and clinical features using a 70/30 train-test split. Report the top 10 most important features and the test accuracy.

expected_output.guidelines: At least 7 of the 10 highest-ranked features by importance must overlap with the reference set; importance scores for overlapping features within +/-0.05; row order and column labels may differ.
Test accuracy value must be within +/-0.05 of the reference; column naming and label formatting may differ.
